grilling.description: Stress-test a plan one question at a time. Explore facts, resolve decisions with the user, and wait for shared understanding before acting.
grilling.whenToUse: Use before implementation when a plan, requirement, or decision needs challenging. Ask for a grilling session to uncover assumptions and agree on the scope.

frontend-design.description: Design and implement distinctive, polished interfaces. Use it to improve a working page's typography, layout, color, and visual hierarchy.
frontend-design.whenToUse: Use when building a page or component, or when an existing interface needs a deliberate visual direction and more polished layout, typography, or styling.

ship-it.description: Ship the current change for review: run the tests, commit to a feature branch, open or update the pull request, and wait for its live preview URL.
ship-it.whenToUse: Use after making a change in this hub when you want a pull request and a live preview for review. It does not merge the change.

microsoft-foundry.description: Deploy, evaluate, and manage Microsoft Foundry agents. Reference content only for this demo; using it requires Azure access and the Azure MCP tools.
microsoft-foundry.whenToUse: Read this reference when exploring Foundry agent deployment, evaluation, monitoring, or troubleshooting. Executing its workflows requires Azure access and the Azure MCP tools; it is not for general Azure deployments.
